verified.entry_point: library API: League\CommonMark\MarkdownConverter::convert with CommonMarkCoreExtension plus SmartPunctExtension (reported route) or AttributesExtension
routes: SmartPunct unpaired quote cleanup: text nodes re-copied per quote
Attributes multi-line attribute block: accumulated set re-merged per line
Attributes inline and block nodes targeting one element: accumulated set re-merged and re-filtered per node (class lists and other attribute names)
Attributes target resolution: inline attribute runs at the start of a block and contiguous TARGET_NEXT block runs re-scan their sibling chain per node
verified.services: none: a PHP library; the verifier runs the PHP CLI only, offline
verified.project_tests_run: phpunit tests/unit tests/functional for the Attributes and SmartPunct areas (110 tests, 180 assertions) pass on the pinned commit and on the reference fix; the full unit+functional suite (4250 tests) passes with the complete development vendor except the two Embed tests whose optional package is not part of the reduced verifier vendor

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected outcome is conversion time, not access to a resource or object
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: conversion is a single operation with no read/write split
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no value is adjusted, clamped or normalised between the input and the sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or caller-supplied name is parsed before the sink
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority or secret whose absence could make the check fail open

traps.shape: Many unpaired smart quotes; each quote cleanup merges into the same growing text node, and the shared merge copies the whole accumulated literal per quote
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the helper is shared with the core parse path, so it reads as already linear

traps.shape: A multi-line attribute block; every continuation line re-merges the whole accumulated set, and class lists round-trip through explode/implode each time
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; a few lines are the documented use, and the class value must stay a space-joined string

traps.shape: Many inline or block attribute nodes applying to one element; each node re-merges and re-filters the whole accumulated set, for class lists and for every other attribute name
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the listener runs once per node, so one cheap-looking merge hides the rebuild

traps.shape: An attribute run whose nodes resolve their target by walking the sibling chain: inline attributes that start a block or follow an inline sibling, and contiguous block-level TARGET_NEXT runs
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; each node is detached as it is processed, so the walk looks amortized until a run starts a container
